rows.note: Use this specifically for reducing the size of computer data or files.

example.english: This program uses data compression to make the file much smaller.
example.traditional: 呢個程式用數據壓縮，令個檔案細好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 jung6 sou3 geoi3 aat3 suk1 ling6 go3 dong2 on3 sai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for compaction or the process of making something denser.

example.english: This storage bag relies on compression to save space, so it is convenient for travel.
example.traditional: 呢款收納袋靠壓縮慳位，旅行用好方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 sau1 naap6 doi2 kaau3 aat3 suk1 haan1 wai2 leoi5 hang4 jung6 hou2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the compression stroke in an internal-combustion engine.

example.english: This engine is currently in the compression stroke.
example.traditional: 呢部引擎而家行緊壓縮衝程。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 jan5 king4 ji4 gaa1 haang4 gan2 aat3 suk1 cung1 cing4

rows.jyutping: dung6 taai3 faan6 wai4 aat3 suk1
rows.note: Use this for audio processing that automatically narrows the difference between loud and quiet sounds.

example.english: The sound engineer uses dynamic range compression to reduce the difference between loud and quiet sounds.
example.traditional: 錄音師會用動態範圍壓縮，減少大細聲之間嘅差距。
example.jyutping: luk6 jam1 si1 wui5 jung6 dung6 taai3 faan6 wai4 aat3 suk1 gaam2 siu2 daai6 sai3 seng1 zi1 gaan1 ge3 caa1 geoi6
